Problem Statement:
Bubble sort is based on the idea of repeatedly comparing pairs of adjacent elements and then swapping their positions if they exist in the wrong order. 
Given an array of size N.You have to sort the given array of integer values in bubble sort manner. 
Input Description:
Given an integer 'n' which indicates the length of array and followed by space separated ‘n’ integer values.Where 1 
Output Description:
Print step by step process of applying bubble sort(print all the iteration of bubble sorting process). where 1 
Explanation:
From the given input 74 44 15 12 23 10 90,starts with very first two elements 74 and 44, comparing 74>44 swap two 74 and 44 and again compare with next element repeat this process until 74 will reach correct position.Result of first pass 44 15 12 23 10 74 90.After last pass,Finally got the sorted array as 10 12 15 23 44 74 90.

7
74 44 15 12 23 10 90
